what: 6-24 values over time as one line that draws itself left to right, the last point on the dot with its value, an optional stated change and a label
use_when: 6-24 values in time order from the articles: a series whose direction matters more than any single point
avoid_when: 3-5 labelled points (trend), one value then and now (change), values that are not in time order (bars, chart)
rules: "sparkline": 6-24 values in time order, one unit, every point stated in the article; "delta" is a change the article states (an arrow follows its sign), never a difference you computed;
